description: Recover recent jobs after losing a job ID. Filter by status, job type, creation date, brand, property, brief or item. Returns status, errors, timing and content references. Inspect jobs and saved versions before repeating generation.

job_type.description: Exact stored job-type name, including retired types. Must not be blank.
job_type.title: Job Type

anyOf.description:
Status of a background job.

Terminal states: ``completed``, ``completed_with_errors``, ``failed``,
``cancelled``. Active (in-progress) states: ``queued``, ``running``.

``awaiting_review`` is a third class: not terminal (work may resume after a
human action) and not active (no automatic progress is being made). Pollers
should treat it as stop-and-review rather than keep waiting for a terminal
status. It is intentionally in neither ``is_terminal`` nor ``is_active``.
anyOf.title: JobStatus
